name: Deletes a `Printer`.
Returns a `Printer` resource (printer's config).
Updates a `Printer` resource.
context:
PATCH /admin/directory/v1/{name}
Updates a `Printer` resource.
Required: name (path) — Identifier. The resource name of the Printer object, in the format customers/{customer-id}/printers/{printer-id} (During printer creation leave empty); body (body)
Optional: clearMask (query) — The list of fields to be cleared. Note, some of the fields are read only and cannot be updated. Values for not specified fields will be patched.; updateMask (query) — The list of fields to be updated. Note, some of the fields are read only and cannot be updated. Values for not specified fields will be patched.; fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Deletes a print server.
context:
DELETE /admin/directory/v1/{name}
Deletes a print server.
Required: name (path) — Required. The name of the print server to be deleted. Format: `customers/{customer.id}/chrome/printServers/{print_server.id}`
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Returns a print server's configuration.
description: Returns a print server's configuration. GET /admin/directory/v1/{name}
context:
GET /admin/directory/v1/{name}
Returns a print server's configuration.
Required: name (path) — Required. The [unique ID](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/reference/rest/v1/customers) of the customer's Google Workspace account. Format: `customers/{id}`
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Updates a print server's configuration.
description: Updates a print server's configuration. PATCH /admin/directory/v1/{name}
context:
PATCH /admin/directory/v1/{name}
Updates a print server's configuration.
Required: name (path) — Identifier. Resource name of the print server. Leave empty when creating. Format: `customers/{customer.id}/printServers/{print_server.id}`; body (body)
Optional: updateMask (query) — The list of fields to update. Some fields are read-only and cannot be updated. Values for unspecified fields are patched.; fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.
